RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: Bitbear [post@bitbear.org]
RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: Plugin Updater
RenoiseScriptingTool.Category: plugin vst vst3 au clap upgrade update outdated broken
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Scans the current song for outdated or broken plugin devices (track FX and instrument plugins), finds the best installed candidate (preferring CLAP > VST3 > VST > AU and higher versions), and upgrades them while attempting to transfer the previous preset/state. Includes a safe dry-run report mode and never saves the song automatically.
